about_the_game:
In the land of Eldrath, and evil dragon has kidnapped Penelope, the king's daughter.  The fear is that the dragon will make a meal out of Penelope, rescue is needed, but alas, no one is brave enough.  So another hero must be found, outside the realm.

You as the player take on the role of Doug, an unlikely hero who was zapped into the universe of dungeons and magic.  Doug was minding his own business playing the latest Dungeon arcade game, when he was zapped into the game.  He is tasked with rescuing the king's daughter Penelope from the evil Dragon. 

Prepare to descend into darkness. Dungeon is a retro-inspired, 90s-style first-person shooter dungeon crawler(think Don Bluth meets Gauntlet)  that puts you in the heart of relentless, fast-paced action.  Arm yourself with courage and steel, and battle through treacherous depths to confront the malevolent dragon and rescue Penelope.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 560
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: Dungeon: Order of the Raven is a '90s FPS retro-inspired dungeon crawler that combines fast-paced action, treasure hunting, and strategic combat. As a brave adventurer, you’ll descend into the depths of a treacherous dungeon, battling relentless waves of beasts and uncovering hidden treasures.
